values: 躲进影子跟随目标移动，期间处于无敌状态，持续对目标造成伤害并吸收能量。之后跳出来对1格范围内的敌人造成伤害并恐惧。

Berial hides within the shadow and follows the target, dealing damage to the target and absorbing Energy continuously, during which he becomes invincible. Then he jumps out to damage and frighten adjacent enemies.
飞到敌人的影子并藏匿其中，每0.25秒对其造成36% ATK伤害，并吸收15 + 5点能量，最多持续5秒，持续期间自身处于无敌状态。随后从影子中跳出来对1格范围的敌人造成320% + 30% ATK伤害并恐惧4秒。

Berial flies beneath the enemy, hiding within their shadow and dealing 36% ATK damage every 0.25s, absorbing 15 + 5 Energy, lasting up to 5s. Berial is invincible during the effect. Then he jumps out from the shadow, dealing 320% + 30% ATK damage to adjacent enemies and frightening them for 4s.
躲在影子里面每0.25秒对敌人造成的伤害提升至38% ATK。
Deals 38% ATK damage to enemies every 0.25s when hiding in the shadow.
躲在影子里面每0.25秒对敌人造成的伤害提升至40% ATK。
Deals 40% ATK damage to enemies every 0.25s when hiding in the shadow.
躲在影子里面每0.25秒对敌人造成的伤害提升至42% ATK。
Deals 42% ATK damage to enemies every 0.25s when hiding in the shadow.
躲在影子里面每0.25秒对敌人造成的伤害提升至45% ATK。
Deals 45% ATK damage to enemies every 0.25s when hiding in the shadow.
躲进影子，若场上有孤立目标，会跳到孤立目标身边造成伤害，否则在影子中持续回复生命值，最后回到原位。
Berial hides within the shadow. If isolated enemies exist, he moves toward the targets and deals damage. Otherwise, restoring HP continuously within the shadow and returning to his original tile.
躲进影子，期间自身处于无敌状态。若场上有孤立的敌人，还会依次移动到每个孤立的敌人身边，造成300% + 30% ATK伤害，否则会躲藏在影子中，并回复共300% ATK生命值。随后在原位置出现。

Berial hides in shadow, and becomes invincible while hidden. If there are isolated enemies on the battlefield, Berial will move to each isolated target in turn, dealing 300% + 30% ATK damage to each target. Otherwise, he will stay in the shadow, and recover a total of 300% ATK HP, before returning to his original tile.
对孤立目标造成的伤害提升至310% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to the isolated targets to 310% + 30% ATK.
对孤立目标造成的伤害提升至320% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to the isolated targets to 320% + 30% ATK.
对孤立目标造成的伤害提升至350% + 30% ATK。
Increases the damage dealt to the isolated targets to 350% + 30% ATK.
被击败后，贝利尔会躲进敌人影子中一段时间，期间贝利尔视为已被击败，但当场上有非召唤物的敌人被击败时，贝利尔会从这名敌人处复活并回复一定生命值。
Berial hides within the shadow for a while after being defeated. Upon a non-summoned enemy is taken down, he will revive from the vanquished enemy and restore a certain amount of HP.
被击败后，贝利尔会躲藏在敌人的影子中，持续10秒。期间贝利尔视为已被击败，但当场上有非召唤物的敌人被击败时，则贝利尔会从被击败的这名敌人处重新加入战斗，并回复40% + 6% HP的生命值。该效果一场战斗内只会触发一次。

Berial hides within the shadow for 10s after being defeated. However, during which, if a non-summoned enemy is taken down, Berial will revive from the vanquished enemy and return to the battlefield with 40% + 6% HP HP. This effect can only be triggered once per battle.
重新上阵时回复的生命值提升至45% + 6% HP。
Increases Berial's restored HP to 45% + 6% HP after revival.
重新上阵时回复的生命值提升至50% + 6% HP。
Increases Berial's restored HP to 50% + 6% HP after revival.
重新上阵时回复的生命值提升至60% + 6% HP。
Increases Berial's restored HP to 60% + 6% HP after revival.
“孤立”状态的敌人造成伤害降低，受到伤害提升。
Berial reduces the damage dealt by an isolated enemy and increases the damage they take.
“孤立”状态的敌人造成伤害降低6%，受到伤害提升3%。
Berial reduces the damage dealt by an isolated enemy by 6% and increases their damage taken by 3%.
“孤立”状态的敌人造成伤害降低8%，受到伤害提升4%。
Berial reduces the damage dealt by an isolated enemy by 8% and increases their damage taken by 4%.
“孤立”状态的敌人造成伤害降低10%，受到伤害提升5%。
Berial reduces the damage dealt by an isolated enemy by 10% and increases their damage taken by 5%.
若场上有非召唤物的敌人持续处于孤立超过一定时间，会在目标身边出现一个目标的残影，残影会持续损失生命值并使用普通攻击对敌人造成伤害。
If non-summoned enemies remain isolated for a while, they will generate a Silhouette that loses its HP over time and can only deal damage by normal attacks.
若场上有非召唤物的敌人持续处于孤立超过3秒，则该敌人会失去180点能量并在身边出现一个目标的残影，残影继承贝利尔50%的攻击力、生命值和100%的其他属性，且每秒损失8%最大生命值，持续期间残影只会使用普通攻击对该目标造成伤害。同一个角色20秒内最多触发一次该效果。

If non-summoned enemies remain isolated for over 3s, they lose 180 Energy and generate a Silhouette that inherits 50% of Berial's ATK, HP, and 100% of other stats. The Silhouette loses 8% of its max HP per second. This effect can only be triggered once on the same target within 20s, and the Silhouette can only deal damage by normal attacks.
残影继承的攻击力、生命值提升至自身的70%。
The Silhouette inherits 70% of Berial's ATK and HP.
残影对敌人造成伤害时，会使敌人损失40点能量。
Enemies lose 40 Energy when they receive damage from the Silhouette.
残影继承的攻击力、生命值提升至自身的80%。
The Silhouette inherits 80% of Berial's ATK and HP.
被击败后，技能“恶魔契约”躲藏时间延长。
Increases the hiding duration after being defeated.
被击败后，技能“恶魔契约”的躲藏时间延长10秒。
Increases the hiding duration after being defeated by 10s.
“二重身”对每名角色的触发时间降低至8秒。首次召唤残影后，自身和残影对敌人造成的能量损失效果提升50%。累计召唤3次残影后，残影将不再自动损失生命值。

Berial reduces the per-enemy cooldown of Silhouette summons from Shadow Reflection to 8s. After summoning his first Silhouette, the Energy loss inflicted by Berial and his Silhouettes increases by 50%. Once 3 Silhouettes have been summoned, they no longer lose HP over time.
